Job Description:

Title: QA Automation Analyst - P2

Location: Remote – Canada

Reports to: Team Lead - Quality Assurance

Vacancy: Existing vacancy

The Role:

The Quality Assurance Automation Analyst II contributes to all phases of the Software Testing Lifecycle through the analysis, design, execution, and maintenance of software test suites. This role works closely with Business Unit stakeholders to review requirements, validate designs, create work estimates, and verify product releases. The Quality Assurance Automation Analyst III also works in close collaboration with the Quality Assurance Team Lead to define and implement best practices across all phases of the Software Testing Lifecycle.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

In this role, you will transform how we validate software quality by building and maintaining comprehensive automated test frameworks that catch issues early and accelerate our release cycles. Your work will empower the development team to ship with confidence, reduce costly production incidents, and free up resources to focus on innovation, creating measurable business value across the organization.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

  • Develop a detailed technical understanding of client needs and project requirements

  • Work with Solution Analysts to review and provide feedback for Software Requirements Specifications

  • Contribute to Software Test Plans to define the scope, objective, and approach of testing activities

  • Collaborate with technical stakeholders to create detailed work package estimates

  • Develop and execute integration, system, and acceptance level automated tests to verify requirements

  • Create and review software testing defect, progress, and summary reports

  • Contribute to the investigation and triage of software defects for assigned projects

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science or Software Engineering

  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests using Selenium, Cucumber, Playwright, REST Assured, Java, or JUnit for UI modules built on java and Web services

  • 3+ years of experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.

  • Experience writing basic SQL data retrieval queries using joins.

  • Experience with web servers such as Apache HTTP Server or NGINX

  • Experience with version control software such as Git or Perforce

  • Experience with API testing of RESTful and SOAP-based web services using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or other API testing frameworks.

  • Experience with build tools such as Maven or Ant or Gradle

  • Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins or TeamCity

  • Detailed knowledge of all phases in the Software Testing Lifecycle

  • Experience designing and executing test suites for unit, integration, system, and acceptance test levels.

  • Experience working with a variety of software development languages (mainly java programming)

  • Familiarity with Typescript as a language (use for Playwright)

  • Familiarity with service-oriented architecture and design principles

  • Familiarity with relational and non-relational database design

  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.

  • Exceptionally self-motivated, self-directed, and detail-oriented

  • Superior analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Familiar with leveraging AI/LLM-based tools and models to enhance test planning, automate test generation, and improve overall QA efficiency.

The Hiring Manager says:

We are looking for a qualified professional with strong technical proficiency in automation tools and a strategic approach to quality assurance. Your contributions will establish robust testing frameworks, reduce defect rates, and ensure the delivery of exceptional software solutions to our clients. We welcome analytical, detail-oriented candidates ready to take ownership of quality outcomes.

This position has a starting salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 CAD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday

  • Maintain ownership of lifecycle of call, including follow up and escalation to supervisors where necessary.
  • Meet daily qualitative and quantitative targets, and achieve all objectives for service, productivity, and quality.
  • Adhere to contact center scheduling, ensure telephone coverage during contact center hours of operations.
  • Perform clerical or administrative tasks.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Complete all required compliance training.
Skills and Competencies:
  • Excellent communications skills both verbal and written.
  • Experience using MS Office and Teams.
  • 1-3 years of previous experience in a call center or customer support role.
  • Knowledge of customer service practices and principles.
  • Excellent data entry and typing skills.
  • Superior listening, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations appropriately.
  • Positive attitude, team player mentality, and willingness to learn and adapt.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and decision-making skills.
  • Must be comfortable with multi-tasking and working in a fast-paced, high-volume call center.
  • Ability to demonstrate empathy and professionalism.
  • Maintain a reliable internet connection on a designated computer in a quiet, secure, confidential workspace.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours to support business needs and various time zones.
  • Maintains regular, punctual attendance, and follows company timekeeping policy.

Required:

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, as needed.
Preferred:
  • Previous experience in a Medicaid or health insurance industry contact center.

Role Title: CRM Operations Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging CRM Operations Specialists to support a customer's project focused on optimizing sales and customer relationship management processes. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This is an opportunity to leverage your CRM operations skills and deep knowledge of platforms like Salesforce and HubSpot, directly impacting the way leading organizations manage and grow customer relationships.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and provide input on CRM workflows, sales processes, and automation logic using Salesforce, HubSpot, and other leading platforms.
  2. Document current sales operations practices, identifying pain points and opportunities for process improvement.
  3. Contribute real-world examples, scenarios, and feedback reflecting best practices in CRM operations and sales enablement.
  4. Review, analyze, and annotate CRM data, records, and user interactions to support AI training objectives.
  5. Assess and validate AI system outputs for accuracy and alignment with actual sales operations.
  6. Collaborate on content generation and review for documentation, training materials, and process guides related to CRM tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 3+ years of hands-on experience in CRM and sales operations, with demonstrated expertise in Salesforce and HubSpot.
  2. Proficiency with additional platforms such as Close, Apollo, Salesloft, Intercom, Freshdesk, Shopify, Crayon, or Funnel is highly valued.
  3. Track record of optimizing sales processes, implementing automations, and managing CRM data integrity.
  4. Strong analytical and process-mapping abilities, with a detail-oriented approach to complex business workflows.
  5. Effective written and verbal communication skills to deliver clear documentation and actionable feedback.
  6. Experience providing feedback or training in process improvement or software implementation contexts is a plus.
  7. No formal degree required; practical expertise and platform fluency are the primary criteria.

Video Editor – Remote

Video Editing | Motion Graphics | Social Media Content | Brand Storytelling

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Flexible to support deadlines and campaign launches)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Video Editor to create engaging, high-quality video content across social media, marketing campaigns, training materials, and branded content.

This is more than a traditional editing role. You’ll transform raw footage into polished, platform-optimized videos that strengthen brand awareness, improve engagement, and support business growth.

Working closely with marketing and creative teams, you’ll produce everything from short-form social videos and paid advertising creatives to explainer videos, educational content, and long-form productions.

If you have a strong eye for storytelling, pacing, audience retention, and visual quality—and enjoy bringing ideas to life through video—this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Storytelling

  • Edit raw footage into polished videos for:
    • Social media
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Websites
    • Internal training
    • Branded content
  • Create compelling stories through:
    • Pacing
    • Sequencing
    • Transitions
    • Visual flow
  • Produce engaging short-form and long-form videos.
  • Ensure every edit aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
  • Deliver clean, professional content with exceptional attention to detail.

Motion Graphics & Visual Branding

  • Add:
    • Titles
    • Captions
    • Lower thirds
    • Callouts
    • Logos
    • Motion graphics
  • Create simple animations and branded visual elements.
  • Maintain consistency across all video deliverables.
  • Elevate content through modern editing techniques and creative enhancements.

Audio Editing & Color Correction

  • Synchronize audio and video accurately.
  • Improve sound quality through:
    • Noise reduction
    • Audio balancing
    • Sound mastering
  • Add licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and color grading to deliver polished final products.

Multi-Platform Video Production

  • Export videos optimized for:
    • YouTube
    • TikTok
    • Instagram
    • LinkedIn
    • Facebook
    • Company websites
  • Deliver multiple aspect ratios and platform-specific formats.
  • Optimize compression while maintaining high visual quality.
  • Ensure every video is publishing-ready and aligned with platform best practices.

Collaboration & Workflow Management

  • Collaborate with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Creative leads
    • Internal stakeholders
  • Manage feedback and revision cycles efficiently.
  • Maintain organized project files, raw footage, assets, and archives.
  • Utilize collaboration platforms such as:
    • Google Drive
    • Dropbox
    • Similar project management tools

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Proficiency with at least one of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
    • Final Cut Pro
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Storytelling
    • Video pacing
    • Audio editing
    • Color correction
  • Experience exporting content for social media and web platforms.
  • Strong project organization and file management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Motion graphics
    • Animation
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertisements
    • UGC content
    • Performance marketing creatives
  • Understanding of:
    • Watch time
    • Engagement metrics
    • Click-through rate (CTR)
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Agencies
    • Media companies
    • Content-driven businesses
  • Familiarity with social-first editing styles for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube Shorts

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Creative storyteller with a strong visual eye.
  • Excellent understanding of audience engagement and retention.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple editing projects.
  • Comfortable receiving and implementing feedback.
  • Passionate about creating high-performing content.
  • Able to balance speed, quality, and consistency under deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review raw footage and organize project assets.
  • Edit videos for social media, campaigns, training, and branded content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, music, and visual effects.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color grading.
  • Export multiple platform-specific versions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders through review cycles.
  • Maintain organized project files and documentation.

In short: You transform raw footage into engaging, high-quality video content that strengthens brand storytelling, supports marketing campaigns, and drives audience engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects
  • High editing quality with minimal revision rounds
  • Strong audience engagement and video performance
  • Consistent brand alignment across all content
  • Organized project files and asset management
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on creativity, quality, and turnaround time

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a diverse range of creative marketing projects.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing and leadership teams.
  • Opportunity to produce content that directly impacts brand growth and audience engagement.
  • Fully remote work environment with creative ownership.
  • Exposure to modern video production tools and content strategies.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Motion Graphics Designer
    • Creative Lead
    • Multimedia Producer
    • Creative Director

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Portfolio Review & Practical Editing Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a creative video editor who enjoys transforming ideas into engaging visual stories, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in delivering polished, high-quality content, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create compelling videos that drive engagement, strengthen brands, and support business growth.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise B2B Sales & High-Ticket DealsPosition Type: Full-Time, Contract, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive – Enterprise B2B Sales & High-Ticket Deals

Position Type: Full-Time, Contract, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Account Executive to own the full B2B sales cycle and close complex, high-value deals with senior decision-makers.

This is a true full-cycle sales role — not a position focused solely on working inbound leads.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Building and maintaining your own pipeline
  • Prospecting and engaging senior decision-makers
  • Running discovery calls and product demonstrations
  • Managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Negotiating and closing high-ticket B2B deals
  • Owning forecasting and revenue targets

If you have a proven track record in enterprise or mid-market B2B sales, consistently hit quota, and are comfortable selling directly to C-suite executives, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the entire sales process from first contact through signed agreement:

  • Prospecting
  • Qualification
  • Discovery
  • Product demonstrations
  • Proposal development
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

Build relationships with prospective customers while maintaining momentum throughout complex buying cycles.

Manage multiple high-value opportunities simultaneously and take full ownership of moving qualified deals toward close.

Pipeline Generation & Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Generate new business through proactive prospecting and follow-up.
  • Identify target accounts and relevant decision-makers.
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across longer sales cycles.
  • Track opportunities, activities, next steps, and deal progression in Pipedrive or similar CRM platforms.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting.

Enterprise & Executive-Level Selling

Engage directly with:

  • C-suite executives
  • Business owners
  • Vice Presidents
  • Directors
  • Department leaders
  • Other key decision-makers and stakeholders

Understand business challenges, strategic priorities, buying motivations, and decision criteria.

Build credibility through consultative, value-driven conversations rather than transactional selling.

Complex Deal Management

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes.
  • Identify champions, decision-makers, influencers, and potential blockers.
  • Manage longer sales cycles and multiple approval stages.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the deal.
  • Maintain momentum through procurement, negotiation, and final approval.
  • Develop clear strategies for advancing stalled or complex opportunities.

Discovery, Demonstrations & Value Selling

  • Run structured discovery calls to uncover business needs, pain points, priorities, and buying criteria.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations.
  • Tailor presentations to the prospect’s specific business objectives.
  • Clearly communicate ROI, business impact, and strategic value.
  • Position solutions as investments tied to measurable outcomes rather than simply products or tools.

Negotiation & Closing

  • Lead pricing and commercial conversations confidently.
  • Handle objections professionally and strategically.
  • Negotiate agreements while protecting deal value.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing prospects from moving forward.
  • Drive opportunities toward clear decisions and signed agreements.
  • Maintain strong relationships throughout the closing process.

Account Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop account-level strategies for priority opportunities.
  • Identify expansion and repeat-business opportunities.
  • Understand target markets and buying patterns.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on value, probability, and strategic importance.
  • Take full ownership of individual revenue performance.

Forecasting & CRM Discipline

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Deal stage
  • Opportunity value
  • Next steps
  • Decision-makers
  • Expected close dates
  • Risks and blockers
  • Forecast probability

Provide reliable revenue forecasts and pipeline updates to leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with:

  • Marketing
  • Product
  • Operations
  • Leadership

Coordinate internal resources to strengthen proposals, presentations, and deal strategy.

Share prospect feedback and market insights to improve messaging, positioning, and the overall sales process.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Stay informed on competitors, market trends, and customer priorities.
  • Understand competitive alternatives prospects may be evaluating.
  • Incorporate relevant market insights into sales conversations.
  • Position the company effectively in competitive opportunities.
  • Share recurring market intelligence with internal stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within enterprise or mid-market environments.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Demonstrated experience closing high-value B2B deals.
  • Strong experience owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Experience selling directly to executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience building and managing your own pipeline.
  • Strong CRM experience with Pipedrive or similar platforms.
  • Excellent discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • SaaS sales
  • Professional services sales
  • High-growth startup experience
  • Enterprise account management
  • 60–180+ day sales cycles
  • Multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
  • Consultative or solution-based selling
  • Account expansion and upselling
  • Experience with Zoom and Google Workspace
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Have consistently closed meaningful B2B revenue.
  • Are comfortable speaking with C-suite executives and business leaders.
  • Can create pipeline instead of relying entirely on inbound opportunities.
  • Know how to run discovery conversations that uncover real business needs.
  • Understand how to sell value and ROI rather than features.
  • Can navigate complex deals involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Are disciplined with CRM management and forecasting.
  • Know when to push a deal forward and when to uncover additional information.
  • Take ownership of your quota and revenue outcomes.
  • Thrive in performance-driven environments with significant autonomy.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Account Executive’s day may include:

  • Prospecting into high-value target accounts.
  • Following up with active opportunities.
  • Running discovery calls with executives and senior stakeholders.
  • Delivering tailored demos and presentations.
  • Preparing proposals and business cases.
  • Handling objections and negotiating commercial terms.
  • Developing strategies for complex or stalled opportunities.
  • Collaborating internally on priority deals.
  • Updating Pipedrive and reviewing pipeline health.
  • Forecasting expected revenue and upcoming closes.
  • Researching target accounts, competitors, and market developments.

In short: you build pipeline, manage complex B2B opportunities, and turn qualified prospects into closed revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue closed
  • Quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Pipeline coverage
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Win rate
  • Average deal size
  • Sales cycle length and deal velocity
  • Forecast accuracy
  • CRM and pipeline accuracy

Why This Role Stands Out

  • True ownership of the complete B2B sales cycle.
  • Opportunity to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Direct interaction with executives and senior decision-makers.
  • High earning potential tied to individual performance.
  • Significant autonomy and ownership over your pipeline.
  • Direct impact on company revenue and growth.
  • Fully remote environment aligned with EST hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Enterprise Account Executive
    • Strategic Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Sales Director
    • Revenue Leadership

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview
  • Final Interview with Leadership
  • Background Verification

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your B2B sales background and the types of solutions you’ve sold.
  • The typical deal sizes and sales cycles you’ve managed.
  • Your experience selling to C-suite and senior decision-makers.
  • Your approach to generating your own pipeline.
  • A complex or high-value deal you successfully closed.
  • Your quota attainment and sales performance.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate, sell, and approach complex B2B opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 6+ years of B2B sales experience.
  • Have a proven record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Can build pipeline and close high-value opportunities.
  • Are confident selling to executives.
  • Thrive in complex, full-cycle sales environments.
  • Want direct ownership of revenue outcomes.

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
The Product Security Engineer is responsible for conducting comprehensive security assessments on various products, including mobile applications, IoT hardware/firmware, compiled software, and browser extensions. This role involves identifying vulnerabilities, developing mitigation strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance security. The engineer will use both offensive and defensive security tactics to safeguard products and manage third-party risk. This role contributes to the organization's mission by safeguarding the supply chain and managing third-party risk.

Primary Accountabilities:

Technical (70%)

  • Conduct comprehensive security assessments of mobile applications, IoT hardware / firmware, compiled software and browser extensions.

  • Perform reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis, and penetration testing to uncover security risks.

  • Analyze binary file formats (PE, ELF, Mach-O) and runtime behaviors for security flaws.

  • Review browser extensions and software plugins for security flaws and compliance with best practices.

  • Perform product data analysis to identify potential vulnerabilities and determine access scope.

Operational (30%)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. - engineering, product, and security) to enhance security measures and improve resilience against cyber threats.

  • Develop and recommend mitigation strategies and risk profiles for identified vulnerabilities.

  • Document findings and communicate security recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Maintain organizational product inventory with security assessment status and secure configuration requirements.

  • Responsible for the production and maintenance of security documentation, such as bill of material repositories and analytical procedure guides.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors of Science in a related field, such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Cyber Security

  • 5-7 years of relevant experience in software exploitation, reverse engineering, malware analysis, or related field; or any equivalent combination of experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to complete the primary job responsibilities

  • Proficient in using debuggers, decompilers, and disassemblers to analyze code for vulnerabilities across various CPU architectures, including ARM and RISC-V.

  • Strong understanding of binary file formats like PE, ELF, and Mach-O, enabling analysis of applications for security flaws

  • Skilled in low-level data extraction and analysis using tools like QEMU and Verilog to identify and verify vulnerabilities through emulation

  • Knowledgeable about Linux loaders, binary packing, and embedded systems tools such as BusyBox, binwalk, and u-boot

  • Experienced in capturing and analyzing network traffic, including using tools like tcpdump and Scapy to dissect proprietary protocols

  • Experienced in BOM enumeration and leveraging tools like CycloneDX for inventory and risk assessment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for identifying and mitigating security risks.

  • Excellent communication skills for documenting findings, providing security recommendations, and effectively disclosing vulnerabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience working in cybersecurity research or security assessment functions.

  • Experience with application security testing and associated static and dynamic analysis tools.

  • Knowledge of cryptographic principles and secure coding practices.

  • Familiarity with security assessment frameworks and compliance standards.

  • Prior experience with radio signals analysis and associated security hardening methodologies.

  • Problem Solving: Gathers and analyzes information to generate and evaluate potential solutions to problems, issues and challenges while weighing the accuracy and relevance of the facts, data and information.

  • Effective Execution: Gathers and analyzes information to generate and evaluate potential solutions to problems, issues and challenges while weighing the accuracy and relevance of the facts, data and information.

What We’re Seeking

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute global executive engagement or customer marketing strategies in a B2B enterprise environment, with clear evidence of business impact.

jobs.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Media buying is now the easy part. In 2026, the buying itself is piping.
jobs.description:
Media buying is now the easy part.

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

You are the account manager. We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You are the creative strategist. You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

You build the things the account needs. If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You carry up to six accounts. That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

You can live anywhere. We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

Run the research before the ads. Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in this account.

Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work. Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

Ship creative on a cadence. Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

Build and test landing pages. Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

Report on new customer economics. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

You're a fit if

You've done this with real money. Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

You're AI-native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level. Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

You can communicate your ideas. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

You have taste and you know when to hand off. You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

Bonus: you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

You're not a fit if

  • "That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary. It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager, Paid Media
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager to build the operating system for our paid media team, and then run it.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager to build the operating system for our paid media team, and then run it.

Sweat Pants Agency manages around 57 brands and spends between $5M and $10M a month across Meta, Google, TikTok, and AppLovin. We're the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands from zero. Our average client stays with us for over three years.

Our email and SMS side is exceptionally well run. Project management there is tight, the templates exist, the dashboards are live, and nothing slips. Our paid media side is not there yet, and that's the job. This role is paid media only, so you won't be splitting your attention across two teams.

Roughly 25 to 30 accounts sit on the paid media side and are yours to keep in order. You'd be the first person in this seat, which means you're not inheriting a process. You're designing one.

The first things you'd own

We think in rocks, meaning the things that need pushing uphill. Here are ours, in priority order.

1. Capacity planning. Right now we don't have a real model for who is working on what, how loaded they are, or what happens when a new account lands. You'd build it: a live view of capacity across media buyers, designers, and video editors, with the ability to see an overload coming two weeks out instead of the day someone misses a deadline.

2. Creative workflow and process. Creative is our biggest bottleneck and it's cross functional. It spans our graphic design team, our video editors, and our media buyers who double as creative strategists. There's no single pipeline from request to delivery right now. You'd build it, run it, and be the person who guarantees we hit the creative volumes we owe clients every month.

3. Creators and UGC. We source creators constantly and there's no system behind it. You'd own sourcing across Billo, Backstage, email, and wherever else the right person is. That means negotiating rates and turnaround, tracking orders, managing usage rights so we never run an ad we've lost the rights to, tracking costs per account, and making sure markups land correctly on client invoices. If you haven't done this before, you should be genuinely comfortable asking a stranger for a better rate.

4. Client onboarding. We have a process and it needs refining, by someone who does this for a living rather than by me. Account access collection (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Klaviyo, Shopify, TikTok), ClickUp setup, reporting and dashboard configuration, so every launch feels identical.

What you'd do day to day

  • Run ClickUp as the single source of truth. Build and maintain templates, recurring tasks, intake forms, automations, and dashboards. Every account has a current status and a named owner, always.
  • Own capacity planning across the paid media team and flag overload before it becomes a missed deliverable.
  • Track every creative deliverable from request to delivery, including revisions and approvals, and QA the work before it reaches a client.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage creators. Track orders, usage rights, and costs.
  • Own client onboarding end to end and standardize it so every launch runs the same way.
  • Build landing pages and advertorials using Claude Code from time to time.
  • Make sure client reporting and dashboards are set up correctly and stay accurate for every account.
  • Build internal tools, automations, and living SOPs using AI so the whole team runs faster and the same way every time.
  • Catch gaps in communication and delivery before they escalate, and drive follow ups to closure.
  • Schedule and coordinate recurring client and internal meetings, capture action items, and make sure they actually get done.
  • Flag at risk accounts early and escalate.

About the landing pages

We don't sell landing pages as a service. We build them anyway, because a weak page is the most common reason good creative doesn't convert, and waiting on a client's dev team costs us weeks.

Our media buyers already build pages this way. You'd do the same: advertorials, presell pages, and landing page variants built with Claude Code off existing templates and shipped to Shopify or the client's stack. You don't need to be an engineer and you won't be architecting anything from scratch. You need to be someone who can take a brief, work with AI to build the page, QA it, and ship it, and who finds that interesting rather than terrifying.

How we work, and please read this part carefully

This is the part most job posts leave out, and it's the part that actually determines whether you'd be happy here.

We give a lot of autonomy and we mean it. Nobody here is on a time clock and nobody ever will be. If I have to think about what you're doing with your hours, we've already lost. I judge outcomes, not activity.

The flip side is that I'm not a gatekeeper. One of the biggest red flags for me is someone who asks a lot of permission questions. Can I change this, should I do that. No. Just do it and show me. If you need a company card to solve something, you'll have one. You have full trust on day one. It's only ever lost, never earned.

Ownership is the thing we care about most. "That wasn't my role" is a disqualifier here. If creative is the bottleneck on an account, you go fix creative, whether or not it was in your scope. We've all done work outside our lane to get the result.

We judge the first 30 days harshly. We're looking for you to take action early and show that you're self directed. We usually know quickly, and it rarely turns around. What I can tell you is that people who make it past that point almost never leave. Our team retention is exceptional.

Mistakes are fine. Patterns aren't. You'll never hear me raise my voice. When something breaks we look at the process, not the person. My Slack tagline is "everything's my fault." But if the same thing breaks repeatedly, that's a fit problem.

My job is to protect the team. We have let go of clients for being unkind to our people and we'll do it again. I ask you to put clients first, and if there's ever a problem, tell me, because I'll put you first.

I like being wrong. Tell me there's a better way. Nothing here is sacred and everything can change.

Where this goes

On our email side, project management became the pipeline into strategy. Several of our email strategists started as PMs. We're building the same path on paid media. If you want to end up as a media buyer or creative strategist, this is the seat that gets you there, and you'll get your hands dirty along the way, writing creative briefs, launching ads, and sitting in on account reviews.

If you'd rather stay in operations and own this function as it grows, that works too. Tell us which one you want.

Our mission is simple: be the no BS agency partner you love working with.

Requirements

Skills

  • Elite organization and follow through. You close loops without being chased.
  • You build project management systems, you don't just work inside them. Hands on experience standing up or substantially rebuilding a system in ClickUp, Asana, or Monday, including spaces, custom fields, templates, statuses, intake, automations, and dashboards. We will ask you to walk us through one you personally designed.
  • Highly AI enabled, and comfortable building rather than just prompting. You've used Claude, Claude Code, or a comparable agentic tool to actually make something, whether that's a page, a dashboard, an automation, or an internal tool. Tell us what it was and what it replaced. This is non negotiable and we test it.
  • Proactive problem solver who anticipates gaps rather than reacting to them.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. This role is partly client facing, so English fluency is required.
  • Comfortable negotiating. A meaningful part of this role is talking to creators about rates, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Comfortable juggling many concurrent projects and context switching across accounts.
  • Detail obsessed, with a high standard for quality and accuracy.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in project management, creative operations, account management, or agency operations, preferably in a marketing or creative agency setting.
  • Proven ability to manage timelines and deliverables across many projects at once.
  • Hands on experience building and managing a project management system in ClickUp or a comparable tool. This is a hard requirement.
  • Demonstrated AI building, not just AI usage. This is a hard requirement.
  • Working hours with meaningful overlap with US business hours.
  • Bonus: experience with paid media or DTC ecommerce.
  • Bonus: experience sourcing and managing UGC creators or influencers.
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify, Figma, or front end tooling.

Benefits

Why Sweatpants Agency?

We’re not your typical agency. We’re the only agency behind multiple INC #1 fastest-growing companies from scratch. We thrive on innovation, creative problem-solving, and delivering results that make our clients say, “Wow.”If you’re ready to join a team that values your skills, pushes you to grow, and gives you the freedom to innovate, then we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Strengthening SUNCASA Evidence for GESI-Responsive Urban Nature-based Solutions:
jobs.excerpt: BackgroundThe Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) project aims to enhance climate resilience, gender equality, social inclusion (GESI), and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda), and Johannesburg (South Africa).
jobs.description:
Background

The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) project aims to enhance climate resilience, gender equality, social inclusion (GESI), and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda), and Johannesburg (South Africa). This initiative is led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) in partnership with the World Resources Institute, together with local partners. The main objective of SUNCASA is to address climate-induced risks (e.g., floods, landslides, and soil erosion) by implementing GESI-responsive nature-based solutions (NbS). This is aimed at strengthening the resilience of urban communities, watersheds, and biodiversity from the impacts of climate change, while reducing barriers to NbS participation among women and the underrepresented groups. This would be achieved through targeted interventions such as afforestation and reforestation programs, agroforestry, urban greening, and establishment of vegetated buffer zones in affected areas. The project was launched in late 2023, and implementation will be completed by late 2026.

Despite growing interest and investment in urban NbS, relatively little evidence exists regarding how gender-responsive approaches to NbS influence project effectiveness, sustainability, governance, and equity outcomes. Gender-responsive approaches to NbS under SUNCASA are actions to protect, sustainably manage, and restore natural or modified ecosystems that address and challenge gender and social inequalities to promote equity, justice, and inclusion. This intersectional approach also considers diverse knowledge systems, including local knowledge, that result in equitable benefits from decision making and participation in NbS.

As the project nears completion, SUNCASA offers a unique opportunity to strengthen the evidence base on how GESI-responsive NbS contribute to larger climate adaptation and biodiversity protection outcomes in urban contexts. To this end, IISD seeks to engage an external monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) consultancy team to conduct a theory-based end-of-project evaluation to assess progress toward achieving selected SUNCASA outcomes.

The evaluation will employ theory-based mixed methods, such as key informant interviews (KIIs) and focus group discussions (FGDs) for different sets of actors from each city. Deliverables of this opportunity will include a final external evaluation report (reporting against select outcomes) and communications products to showcase SUNCASA’s early impact/outcomes. Given the short project timeline of 3 years, this evaluation will focus on assessing evidence that supports the pathways of change hypothesized by SUNCASA and early signs of impact and sustainability from the project rather than looking for long-term impacts or effectiveness.

This RFP outlines the scope, objectives, and deliverables for engaging a MEL consultancy team for evaluation data collection and final deliverables.

Objective of the Assignment

This evaluation will assess the end-of-project progress toward achievement of selected SUNCASA intermediate and immediate outcomes that targeted decision-makers and local implementing partners participating in the project. Using mixed methods, a theory-based final evaluation report (including thematic case studies as part of the final report) will be developed to assess SUNCASA’s achievements in reaching selected outcomes. This assignment also requests an interim 2-pager communications product prepared to illustrate the early results and lessons from SUNCASA based on the evaluation, to support discussions at key events taking place in October/November 2026. Lastly, a shorter report will also be developed to showcase high-level results from the final report. Specifics regarding the assignment deliverables are provided in Section 3 of this RFP.

The 2-pager has a specific objective, audience and timeline intended for distribution at the Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD COP). This deliverable will be developed first based on validated high-level, available results, with the final report and derived version to be completed at the end of the assignment. Therefore, the assignment includes a total of three (3) written deliverables, as outlined in Section 7 of this RFP. Appendix A presents the list of outcomes to be evaluated and proposed evaluation questions. The consultancy team is expected to review and revise the evaluation questions in collaboration with the IISD team prior to finalizing the evaluation.

As the SUNCASA project has existing quantitative and qualitative data sources, the consultancy team can use existing SUNCASA data as secondary data sources. Existing data includes

• NbS monitoring data (quarterly data on hectares restored, trees and buffer zone plants planted, debris removal, etc.);
• household-level perceived socio-economic and adaptive capacity data (final survey results from community stakeholders);
• community- and household-level stories of change (qualitative one-pagers from participating NbS workers and community members impacted by SUNCASA);
• training participation numbers and pre- and post-raining evaluation results;
• additional project monitoring and learning records across implementation sites as relevant

Tasks and Deliverables

The expected tasks and deliverables for each assignment component are outlined below:

Component 1: Inception report and evaluation design

  • Review project documentation, existing data sets, MEL framework, and relevant literature.
  • Participate in onboarding sessions with IISD and partners.
  • Refine evaluation questions, sampling approach, and methodology.
  • Develop an inception report detailing the proposed approach.

Deliverable 1: Inception report, including:

  • Refined evaluation questions
  • Data collection plan
  • Detailed workplan and timeline
  • Proposed communications/fundraising product (i.e., CBD COP deliverable) and case study ideas

Component 2: Develop data collection and analytical tools and incorporate feedback from inception report

  • Revise tools based on IISD feedback.
  • Develop and finalize data collection tools (KIIs, FGDs).

Deliverable 2: Final data collection tools

Component 3: Conduct in-country data collection across all three cities (Johannesburg, Kigali, and Dire Dawa). The consultancy team will coordinate with local IISD staff regarding participant time and logistics.

  • KIIs
  • FGDs

Deliverable 3: Completion of data collection activities, shared cleaned data (anonymized)

Component 4: Analysis and draft reporting. Analyze primary and secondary evidence to:

  • Develop one draft final evaluation report
  • Develop a two-pager with high-level results (communications piece intended for distribution at the CBD COP). This deliverable is time sensitive and due before the conference begins on October 19.

Deliverable 4: CBD COP two-pager

Deliverable 5: Draft final evaluation report

Component 5: Validation and finalization

  • Final report submitted with revisions applied based on feedback
  • Final derived shortened version submitted

Deliverable 6: Final evaluation report

Deliverable 7: Final shortened evaluation report

The table below presents the proposed dates for each deliverable as a basis for work planning.

Read the full Terms of Reference here

Strengthening SUNCASA Evidence for GESI-Responsive Urban Nature-based Solutions: End-of-project evaluation

Application deadline: August 14, 2026

Application Process

All applications must be submitted in English.

To be considered for this opportunity, interested qualified consultancy teams must submit the following documents in English, using an easy-to-read font (minimum 10-point size). The documents must be submitted electronically in PDF format.

Proposals should include the following:

  • Cover letter outlining the relevant professional experience of proposed consultants, including the availability for the assignment. The Cover Letter should also identify the primary contact person and include their contact details.
  • Technical Proposal (maximum 15 pages, excluding CVs) demonstrating understanding of the assignment and proposed approach to undertake the work, including the methodology, work plan, and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Section 4.
  • Detailed CVs of all proposed consultants (submitted as an appendix to the proposal) highlighting relevant professional experience conducting evaluations of a similar scope and complexity.
  • Financial Proposal must be presented in USD and include the proposed daily rates for the consultant(s) and any additional costs associated with this assignment. All costs must be clearly itemized, aligned with each deliverable outlined in Section 4, and consistent with the scope of work described in this RFP. A separate Budget Narrative must be included to provide additional detail and justification for each budget line item.
  • At least two (2) project profiles highlighting the consultancy team’s past experience conducting evaluations of a similar scope and complexity. For each project profile, include the evaluation scope, project duration, team composition (including number of team members and their respective roles), geographic location(s), brief description of the project, and a description of the actual services provided by the team. Where applicable, indicate the client’s name and the year the assignment was completed.

jobs.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems.
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD94957

Position Overview

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive.

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experiencedSoftware Architectto join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it.

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role.

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma.

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need.

Responsibilities

  • API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract.

  • System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows.

  • Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks.

  • Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews.

  • Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption.

  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams.

  • Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging).

  • Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration.

  • Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience).

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required.

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management.

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams.

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites.

Core:

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS).

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design.

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation).

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL).

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services.

Bonus:

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM.

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems.

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering).

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing.

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing.

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided.

About the Team

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data.

Why Join Us

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company.

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide.

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio.

  • Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry.

  • Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:


In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Position Overview:
The Senior Compliance Systems Analyst supports compliance-related system and process initiatives by serving as the day-to-day subject matter resource for assigned regulatory areas. • Design and, when appropriate, execute test scenarios for assigned regulatory areas; review test results and defect findings; and identify gaps or issues requiring follow-up testing, requirement clarification, or escalation.
• Guide QA resources by clarifying expected behavior and refining test scenarios, while remaining directly involved in testing assigned regulatory areas to confirm that observed system behavior satisfies the underlying requirement.

  • Document requirements, interpretations, decisions, findings, and implementation outcomes in a clear and organized manner that supports audit, examination, and internal review needs.
    • Track open questions, exceptions, and dependencies related to assigned work and proactively follow through with stakeholders to keep items moving toward resolution.

    • Serve as the ongoing compliance owner for assigned LOS functionality, helping ensure rules, workflows, disclosures, and documents remain aligned with current regulatory requirements and internal policies.
    • Evaluate questions or concerns regarding existing compliance logic raised by internal stakeholders and, as applicable, external lenders, and determine whether clarification, additional testing, or updates are needed.
    • Support continuous improvement of LOS compliance by identifying enhancement opportunities, updating requirements, and partnering with stakeholders to implement and validate changes over time.

• Experience performing regulatory research, compliance analysis, requirements drafting, testing support, or implementation support within mortgage or financial services environments, preferred.

About the team

The Shopping AI team is at the heart of Zillow Group’s mission to create a seamless digital real estate marketplace. We build and own the machine learning systems that power Zillow’s core user experiences—like personalized search, recommendations, and display optimization—across our apps and websites. Our close-knit group of engineers and scientists collaborates with product and design to apply the latest AI advancements, tackling large-scale challenges and shaping the future of home shopping at Zillow.

About the role

As an Applied Scientist, you will help drive the next generation of ranking, recommendation, and generative AI systems for Zillow’s home-shopping experience. Your work will directly impact how millions of users discover and shop for homes, as you research, design, and deploy innovative machine learning models that power key product features. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to deliver solutions that make home shopping more intuitive, personalized, and efficient.

You Will Get To

  • Research, design, and prototype new machine learning models for Zillow’s consumer products, including search, ranking, recommendations, and notifications.

  • Lead the full model lifecycle: from ideation and offline experimentation on large datasets to online deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Develop and test novel modeling approaches, such as deep learning architectures and large language models (LLMs), to improve the home-shopping experience.

  • Apply cutting-edge AI techniques, including LLM-based retrieval and RAG-style systems, to create more natural and conversational property search experiences.

  • Optimize how and when homes are displayed to users, ensuring relevance and context in every interaction.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to define, execute, and iterate on impactful projects.

  • Partner with data engineering and infrastructure teams to leverage large-scale distributed data systems for feature engineering and model training.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Who you are

  • Experienced in designing, training, and analyzing machine learning models to solve real-world business problems, not just academic benchmarks.

  • Proficient in Python and familiar with common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, CatBoost, scikit-learn, Hugging Face) and distributed data systems (e.g., Spark, Hive, Databricks, Airflow).

  • Skilled in the scientific lifecycle: hypothesis formation, experiment design, result analysis, and clear communication to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following: search/information retrieval, personalized ranking/recommender systems, or generative AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Brings curiosity and excitement for applying generative AI and LLMs to transform the home-shopping experience.

  • Approaches challenges with ownership, scientific rigor, and a growth mindset.

  • Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. jobs.excerpt: Who Are We? Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute!
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible.

What are we looking for?

You're a Principal-Level Full-Stack Engineer. You haven't just been around the block - you helped decide which blocks were worth building, and which ones should've been bulldozed early.

At this point, programming languages don’t really impress you anymore. You treat them as tools that translate intent into something a compiler or interpreter can run, choosing them pragmatically, discarding them without nostalgia, and never confusing syntax or novelty with actual progress.

You’ve been around long enough to remember when PHP constructors shared their class names, when exceptions were returned instead of thrown, and when Yeoman, Underscore, and CoffeeScript felt like the obvious future. More importantly, you also learned when to stop using those awful, awful, creations.

Despite all that experience, you’ve stayed deeply hands-on, and you’ve never been particularly interested in drifting into management just because that seemed like the default next step. You’re still happiest close to the code.

You bring a distinctly stoic approach to your work. You don’t panic when systems misbehave, you don’t chase drama, and you don’t confuse urgency with importance.

When you join a project, things tend to settle down. Code becomes easier to reason about, systems start to feel calmer, and decisions get clearer. That sense of clarity tends to spread to the people around you, and without any formal mentoring process, they start picking things up simply by working alongside you.

You have a solid, intuitive understanding of hot-path optimization, speculative execution, and lazy initialization, and you’re occasionally surprised that these simple concepts aren’t more widely understood.

And the homelab experiments you keep running at home, purely because you’re curious and can’t help yourself? We definitely want to hear about those.

If reading this feels a little too familiar, this role is likely to be a very good fit.

What will you be doing?

  • Manage your own time while adhering to priorities set by the company.
  • Own complex engineering problems end-to-end, from problem framing and design through to delivery and iteration.
  • Take responsibility for critical areas of the platform, ensuring they remain reliable, performant, and maintainable.
  • Build new features and improve existing ones across our platforms.
  • Refactor legacy and modern codebases pragmatically, balancing long-term health with delivery needs.
  • Write tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure software reliability.
  • Be involved in every phase of the software lifecycle, from ideation to deployment.
  • Participate in (and at times lead) deep technical discussions, helping drive sound decisions and trade-offs.
  • Work hands-on across backend and frontend systems, stepping in wherever the problem lives.
  • Identify inefficiencies and help streamline workflows, reducing unnecessary work.
  • Collaborate closely with other senior engineers, raising the bar through example rather than authority
  • Take ownership of your work, ensuring high-quality results and maintainable solutions.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

  • 15+ years hands-on experience building and maintaining complex web applications
  • Clear technical communication; able to explain and defend design decisions to senior engineers and non-engineers alike
  • Expert PHP developer (12+ years); Symfony or equivalent frameworks
  • 10+ years modern JavaScript; React or Vue (Next/Nuxt a plus)
  • Expert level knowledge in at least one more programming language (Python a plus)
  • Full-stack architecture expertise: monoliths, services, and hybrids
  • Power user cloud deployment and scaling (AWS preferred) experience and abilities
  • Expert Linux user; including daily containerized workflows with Docker
  • Expert in infrastructure automation: Terraform, Ansible
  • Power user level CI/CD pipeline and release workflow ownership
  • Experience in automated testing: unit, integration, E2E; TDD where appropriate
  • Expert level knowledge in and around web security fundamentals: auth, authorization, data protection, secure coding
  • Legacy + modern codebase fluency; ability to work on incremental modernization
  • Strong independent technical ownership and accountability

We are always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits

How We Support Our Contractors

  • An annualised rate of €139,000 + retention bonus scheme: Competitive contractor rate with a generous bonus paid every 6 months based on your time with us.
  • Top-Notch Workstation: We provide the latest MacBook, branded merchandise, and everything you need for an optimal work environment.
  • Global Co-Working Access: Work from a global network of co-working spaces to keep your work-life dynamic and flexible.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy full flexibility in work location and hours, supporting a work-life balance tailored to your needs.
  • Events and Gatherings: Participate in exciting events throughout the year, including team gatherings, cultural events, and other fun activities.
